# Chapter Two: Mornings

The kitchen always smelled of soy sauce and star anise. My grandmother Mei was
already at the stove, the enamel mug beside her where it always sat.

She would call out "come and eat" and the house would fill.

We moved away in 1978, the summer I was seven years old.

My father repaired the red bicycle when the chain came off, which was often.
I rode it 2 miles to school and 2 miles back.
